finalists.label: Angiosarcoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including band-like vascular proliferation and round vascular channels lined by a single layer of endothelial cells.

finalists.label: basal cell carcinoma
finalists.why: It has specific findings, including an ill-defined, nonindurated, erythematous-violaceous plaque, but lacks strong evidence compared to Angiosarcoma.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of band-like vascular proliferation and round vascular channels lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, as well as the positive immunostaining for CD34 and CD31, strongly supports Angiosarcoma.
